args.name: Restore a renewable food supply
args.function: Provide a learnable practical method to cultivate or tend depleted edible plants so that sustained work can produce a renewable food supply under suitable physical conditions.
args.conditions: At tick 94 my health is 100, satiety 79.4 and energy about 22.56. A bounded root search ended after collecting zero roots because no reachable ripe sources or unseen observed ground remained in its area. Several personally observed local food plants were empty. I own two roots and 0.9 berry. Roots have recorded nutrition 14 and toxicity zero. Local soil is ordinary with moisture 0.65.
args.inputs: Existing food plants, suitable ground, and whatever planting material, tools or water a feasible method requires. Required inputs and propagation methods are unknown; possession of roots does not establish that they can be planted.
args.costs: Unknown. Specify realistic learning time, effort, materials, growth time and prerequisites. No free food, instant replenishment or presumed mastery.
args.effects: Enable a physical trial of cultivation or plant tending with observable progress and a conditional harvest, respecting resource stocks, growing conditions and failure possibilities.

candidates.effects: Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

candidates.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
candidates.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
candidates.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

candidates.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
candidates.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
candidates.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

candidates.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Search an area around an origin for sources of one known resource and collect up to a quantity, one navigate, probe or gather step per round, within path, time and energy limits.
candidates.costs: No cost of its own: each round runs one ordinary step at its own cost. navigate: actual distance x 2 energy, raised by ground and carried mass, at most 0.8 distance per round; probe observe: 1 round, 0.2 energy; gather: 1 round, 2 energy per unit. Each step is priced first against the path, time and energy left and the energy reserve; a step that does not fit is not taken and the search stops. time counts every round since start, paused ones too. Study: 1 round; needs navigate, probe and gather.
candidates.effects: start: resource, radius around x, y (default your position), path, time, energy, reserve, quantity. Candidates: sources of that resource you see now, or remember out of view, inside the radius, with ripe stock; nearest reach first; sources made by another person are left alone. It walks to one with navigate, inspects it with probe, then gathers min(stock, quantity left, units the energy allows). Sources seen empty are noted, not visited. If none is known it may walk to observed dry ground inside the radius to see its unseen parts; one known but beyond the limits stops it. It completes at the quantity or when nothing is left (perhaps with 0), and stops at a limit, health <= 60, satiety <= 8, body temperature 10 from 22 or an injury in the last round. Another action pauses it; resume rechecks all; cancel or death ends it. Nothing is refunded, created or eaten; no reward.

candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Leaves a persistent name sign where you stand that nearby people can see. No physical effect.

candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Leaves a persistent mark sign where you stand that nearby people can see; your 24 most recent names and marks persist. No physical effect.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"wren\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The related-capability search and available registry records identify observation/testing, gathering, travel and bounded searching, but no operation that physically cultivates plants or maintains growing conditions. Gathering transfers existing ripe stock; searching does not restore it. Develop a general plant-tending operation through the current-conversation development handoff. The smallest feasible version tends an existing living, rooted edible plant; it does not assume that harvested roots are propagules. Depleted harvestable stock does not itself establish that a plant is dead or unable to regrow. The applicant's recorded soil moisture and historical plant observations warrant a conditional physical trial, not a guaranteed harvest.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: tend-plants(target, mode, quantity), applicable to any reachable, eligible rooted plant or small contiguous planting patch. Modes are prepare, maintain and inspect; these share one project and physical eligibility model, not separate assessment abilities. Initial executable scope is cultivation of established living plants, not seed creation, resurrection, or unverified planting of food. Target and work quantity are explicit arguments, never hard-coded to Wren or a particular specimen.\\nReferences and code reuse: reuse probe for ordinary visible inspection, navigate for travel, gather for eventual harvesting, and the existing source growth, soil, weather, inventory, decay and action-cost implementations wherever applicable. Record those implementation dependencies and reused code in the handoff. bounded-resource-search remains a separate way to find sources and is not reimplemented. start-3-roots and commons-root-5-0 are historical target references only, supported by start-3-roots:observed-state and commons-root-5-0:observed-state; neither is asserted reachable, alive or currently unchanged. item-26-wren-255 contains two harvested roots and item-39-wren-382 contains 0.9 berry: neither is reserved, planted or consumed by this approval. The visible sand, branches and reeds are not automatically tools, fertilizer, planting material or water.\\nDevelopment gate: implement actual source eligibility and persistent tending effects before publishing this interface. Inspect the implementation facts available to the development handoff, not through new world queries. Reuse the established growth evaluator and its numerical growth times and capacities when it supports regrowth. Publish those applicable timings and condition requirements in the executable contract. If an eligible plant has no modeled regrowth mechanism, add the smallest explicit living-rootstock regrowth mechanism supported by its plant biology, including biomass, environmental inputs, growth stages and failure rules; do not infer vegetative propagation from the food resource name. If biology cannot support regrowth, that target is ineligible, not grounds to reject the general capability. No fixed-era unlock or unrelated activity chain is required. Missing necessary soil or growth state belongs to this development handoff.\\nPrerequisites: individually completed study; a presently reachable, living rooted plant with a supported regrowth mechanism; actual accessible ground; suitable temperature, moisture and rooting conditions; and physical ability to perform the selected treatment. Establish ordinary visible facts through probe. Internal eligibility checks must not disclose unobserved source locations, hidden stock or untested propagation properties. Ownership and access rules remain unchanged. A remembered empty source must be revisited before work.\\nMinimal treatment: cultivate a small patch around established plants by safe shallow hand loosening where modeled surface crusting or compaction limits infiltration or aeration, and by removing competing vegetation only where such competition physically exists and removal is safe and authorized. The contract must specify safe working depth and disturbance tolerance for eligible plant types. Ordinary suitable soil receives no fabricated improvement. Where neither treatment is appropriate, preparation reports that no corrective work is indicated; inspection can establish a baseline and the plant can continue its ordinary regeneration. No treatment guarantees accelerated growth. Removing living material changes that material into explicitly tracked cut biomass or local litter, not edible inventory or free fertilizer. Do not harvest or damage the food plant under the guise of clearing. Watering is not silently included: it requires a separately executable transfer of a measured amount of actual accessible water with an appropriate vessel or conveyance and lawful access. If that transfer is necessary and missing, include its minimal implementation as a dependency in this same handoff, with extraction, transport, spill, capacity and soil-water accounting. No water is granted here.\\nWork costs: one small patch is at most one square unit. Prepare requires three active rounds at two energy per completed round, with three recorded work increments. Maintain requires one active round and one energy per patch, and applies only a presently needed supported treatment. Ordinary probe inspection retains its own registered cost rather than an invented duplicate charge. Travel, carrying, gathering and water handling retain their separate costs. Bare hands suffice only for soft, safely workable ground; harder ground requires an actual suitable tool and its wear, otherwise work cannot start. No material is needed for eligible hand loosening. No energy is charged for a rejected preflight check. Price each work increment before execution; insufficient energy or unsafe physical conditions pauses work without spending an unavailable resource. Hunger and environmental exposure continue normally on elapsed rounds; study or work never grants food, health or energy.\\nProgress and effects: persist patch identity, target references, treatment type, work completed, actual inputs, resulting soil or competition change, last maintenance round and observation evidence. Each completed increment changes only its recorded portion of ground. Completed preparation enables only the physical soil changes actually performed. Growth runs on elapsed simulation rounds through the shared plant evaluator, independently of whether the actor is present, using light, moisture, temperature, living plant state and nutrient availability. Soil moisture 0.65 alone is not proof of complete suitability. Growth accumulates biomass before ripeness; harvestable stock increases only on a supported maturation event and never beyond plant/patch capacity. Photosynthesis, water uptake and soil nutrient use must be represented as bounded environmental flows, not an inventory-to-food multiplication. Existing growth must not run twice because a patch has been tended. Repeated prepare/maintain calls cannot stack growth multipliers or reset maturity clocks.\\nMaintenance and time: the executable contract must expose the plant-specific minimum growth interval, target-condition ranges and maintenance triggers derived from its implemented model before a trial starts. There is no immediate refill and no universal promised harvest deadline. Physical benefits persist until actual settling, competing regrowth or weather reverses them, under explicit decay rules. Maintenance does not become a paid ritual when no work is needed. Drought, waterlogging, unsuitable temperature, damage and depleted inputs can slow, halt or kill growth. Existing ripe stock and gathered items retain ordinary decay. A finished crop is a real source stock harvested through gather, with its normal energy cost and transfer accounting; nutrition and toxicity apply only through eat. A sustainable supply requires regrowth inputs and surviving plant tissue to remain adequate over repeated actual harvest cycles.\\nInterruption and refunds: another action pauses labor; resume rechecks reach, conditions, target survival, access and remaining costs, retaining completed physical work. Cancel ends the work order without undoing soil changes or stopping ordinary plant growth. Death ends the actor's work order but leaves physical plants, soil, litter and any lawful stored materials in the world. No consumed energy, elapsed time, spilled water or completed labor is refunded. Unspent inputs remain where they physically are; return reserved but unconsumed inventory reservations on cancel or death without creating duplicate items. Plant destruction invalidates unfinished work; completed changes remain only where physically meaningful. No other person is made to help, communicate, transfer goods or grant permission automatically. Development and review waiting advance no simulation time. All eligibility, accounting, growth, maintenance, interruption and event rules execute in code, not repeated model review.\",\"learning\":3,\"experienceReview\":\"Study takes three individual simulation rounds; registration, requests, naming, querying and mastery grant no experience benefit. A completed, personally applicable physical trial may yield verified information, including evidence that a suitable-looking plant does not regrow under the tested conditions; record the actual observation and its limits, not universal biological knowledge. Any brief pleasure is optional, event-backed, at most one unit per completed useful treatment, informative trial outcome or harvest, with a ten-round functional-deduplication cooldown; repeated inspections and split work increments do not each qualify. Slowly maintained satisfaction may rise by at most the configured mentalRate 0.04 per round in which independently meaningful practice or participation actually occurs, capped at one unit for this functional cultivation source and decaying by the configured mentalDecay 0.002 per elapsed round. Familiar useful maintenance may qualify without novelty, but idle waiting and ineffective repetition do not. These effects require personal applicability and must use the existing permitted experience channel, not modify protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions. Physical comfort receives no automatic cultivation bonus and remains capped at 10; basic nutrition is unchanged by mood.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit observable events for work started, each physical work increment, paused/resumed/cancelled work, completed soil treatment, observed trial outcome, visible growth-stage change, ripening, harvest transfer and visible damage or death. Reusable visual metadata includes event type, actor when applicable, target/patch ID, location, treatment mode, completed work versus required work, physically visible soil state, observed plant stage and observation time. Use shared patch/plant components with overlays for disturbed soil, removed competition, wilt, growth and ripe produce only when those states exist. Distinguish work completion from successful regrowth and successful harvest. Failed or unfinished treatment must not show a restored-food or ripe-crop success indicator. Private growth eligibility, hidden stocks and unobserved remote changes are not revealed by interface previews or progress bars.\"}]}"}
